rules:
NAV $250M. Longs: priority longs + Strong Buys; shorts: priority shorts + Strong Shorts. Must take a $10M position in <= 10 days.
  Conviction: priority rank 1-5 = 1.5, other priority = 1.25, strong call = 1.0; +0.25 if our expected return into the next
  lead-program event is >= +25% (longs) / <= -25% (shorts). Top 20 longs and 15 shorts by conviction, then model upside.
  Weight = base (longs 4%, shorts 3% of NAV) x conviction x vol scaler (median vol / own vol, 0.5-1.5),
  capped at 6% of NAV, at 5 days of 20% ADV, and at 2% of the company's market cap. Entry = latest close in the price cache.
  A short XBI hedge holds net exposure at +20%, so P&L is mostly stock selection. No costs, borrow or dividends.

toc.e: Risto-cel updated data + BLA submission as early as YE2026

positions.why: Long: two base-editing assets with human data. BEAM-302 lifted total AAT to 12.4 µM at 60 mg in 29 AATD patients, above the 11 µM protective level, and risto-cel is on track for a sickle-cell BLA as early as YE2026.
positions.name: Beam Therapeutics Inc.

positions.why: Long into the Dec 22 PDUFA: lorundrostat has two positive pivotals (placebo-adjusted SBP −9.1 mmHg in Launch-HTN, −7.9 mmHg in Advance-HTN) on top of background therapy.

positions.why: Long: Carvykti is the best-selling myeloma CAR-T (Q2 net trade sales $657M, ~$2.6B annualized) with a PFS hazard ratio of 0.26 in CARTITUDE-4.
positions.name: Legend Biotech Corporation
